text:
sarah: hey folks — opened PR for a tiny prefetch fix that hits a rare seqlen=1 kv-cache edgecase. https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4287 Can someone take a quick look? It's blocking a canary tonight :eyes:

anika: on it. do unit tests pass locally for you?

sarah: unit + integration are green locally, but CI shows a flaky failure: `kv_prefetch_test::race_condition` 1/50. looks like my mutex reorder might be racy.

tonY: @sarah can you paste the failing log? also what's your desired merge window? i can babysit a deploy after 18:00 PT.

sarah: sure — log snippet from the failing CI run:
```
[ RUN      ] kv_prefetch_test.race_condition
E2026-03-17 14:02:11.123 runtime/kv_cache.cc:218] CHECK failed: kv_map.find(k) == kv_map.end() -- found stale entry
[  FAILED  ] kv_prefetch_test.race_condition (21 ms)
```

mike: quick skim — change looks reasonable, but i'm worried about the lock inversion in `runtime/batcher/kv_cache.cc` around where you hold `global_lock` then call into `batcher` which can take `local_lock`. possible deadlock under load. can you annotate or flip the scopes?

sarah: good catch — pushed a small tweak and added a comment explaining the ordering. also added a micro-regression test that reproduces locally with:
```
bazel test //runtime:kv_prefetch_test --test_arg=--repeat=100
```

ci-bot: CI update: build passed, tests 129/130 (kv_prefetch_test flaky). rerun in progress.

miguel: i'll run the flaky test 200x locally now. if green i'll LGTM and slot this for merge. @tony you still able to watch the rollout?

tonY: yup i'll be online at 18:00 PT and can roll back if anything spikes. :thumbsup:

anika: LGTM after the added assert + comment. :shipit:

sarah: thanks all — requesting merge window 18:15-18:30 PT. PR has revert steps in description and a canary config. i'll monitor logs and post updates here.

sarah: pinging again in 30m before the window. any last concerns?

miguel: none from me, local 200x run passed.

tonY: all good.

sarah: merging in the slot, will update thread with rollout outcome. :rocket:
